note: Talbot County GA zoning ordinance (Sec. 6.2) names an official 'Zoning Map of Talbot County, Georgia', but it is published only as a static document, not as a queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online (county and statewide), the county planning page, qPublic (Schneider viewer, parcels only) and the cities (Geneva, Talbotton, Junction City, Woodland) found no zoning district polygon service. Only paid parcel datasets with zoning attributes exist (Regrid, Dynamo).
